method: Ran a new five-check W6 verifier, the prior seven-check lesson/source audit, and all 14 deterministic Python unit tests. The new invalid-count tests were observed failing first for six Boolean/fractional cases, then passing after exact integer validation. Reviewed current OpenAI and Anthropic rate-limit/error documentation, RFC 9110 §10.2.3, and Python 3.14 built-in types. Built and visually inspected the production lesson in light and dark themes. No model provider was called.

observations.trace: The admission helper now requires exact integer types for active, queued, max_active, and max_queue; the retry helper applies the same boundary to attempt and max_attempts before classifying the error. Regression fixtures reject fractional and Boolean inputs. The full local suite passes 14/14 and the W6 verifier passes 5/5. The production page renders centered at 792px with one Mermaid SVG and no horizontal overflow. The only browser console error is the existing favicon.ico 404.

limitations: The local helper is a deterministic policy model; it does not implement a production queue, atomic shared-budget reservation, provider SDK retries, or fairness scheduling.
The HTTP Retry-After parser and live provider behavior were not tested, and no historical provider experiment was replayed.
